sources.title: Outbound Hormuz transits drop to zero: Update
sources.proof_note: Reports Windward's source-specific vessel counts: no outbound transits in the prior 24 hours, four inbound vessels on Aug. 24, and traffic around 3% of prewar levels. Atlas preserves the provider/methodology boundary and does not convert the sample into exact total physical traffic.
